genius.licensingRegulator: Kyrgyz Republic Financial Market Regulatory and Supervisory Service (FSA)
genius.notes: The July 8, 2025 FSA primary notice confirms state registration of the first KGST stablecoin issue by KGSToken LLC through a public offering in the June 23-27 reporting period; this does not itself establish a security under U.S. law, GENIUS qualification or foreign-exception recognition. The issuer describes fiat/cash-equivalent reserves and reports domestic oversight. Its general reserve page is an issuer disclosure, not an independently verified or monthly attestation report; no actual dated monthly report was located. No named U.S. approval, application, issuer-announced GENIUS plan or foreign registration was found. Treasury's August 17 proposal gives January 18, 2027 as the expected effectiveness date, subject to the statutory final-rule trigger. The September 30 SCRC interim final rule is procedural. not-yet-restricted describes only GENIUS's phased DASP restriction, not general U.S. legality or authorization. The broad DASP prohibition starts July 18, 2028; the foreign lawful-order condition starts when the Act becomes effective.
